name: Joshua M. Joerres
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Joshua M. Joerres is an attorney at the firm Dubin Law Group, which has its offices in Seattle, Washington. With over 21 years of experience in the legal field, he advocates for the rights of clients who have been injured due to another person’s negligence. He takes on cases involving:

Mr. Joerres is a seasoned legal professional with a diverse background, driven by a passion for justice and advocacy. Prior to his current role at Dubin Law Group, he embarked on a multifaceted legal journey, wielding his experience in various capacities.

Mr. Joerres’s tenure as an assistant attorney general honed his understanding of public interest law, while his experience as an insurance defense attorney provided invaluable insights into the workings of insurance companies. Transitioning to a solo-practitioner role, he championed the cause of injured parties, leveraging his legal acumen to hold insurance companies accountable for their actions.

Driven by a desire to ensure fair compensation for the injured and to uphold ethical standards within the insurance industry, Mr. Joerres finds fulfillment in guiding his clients through the legal process. His dedication to their cause is underscored by his unwavering advocacy and meticulous attention to detail.

Mr. Joerres earned his Juris Doctor from Seattle University of Law, graduating cum laude and receiving honors for his exemplary academic performance. Prior to this, he obtained a Bachelor of Science degree from Colorado State University in 1999. He is licensed to practice in Washington and before the U.S. District Court for the Eastern and Western Districts of Washington and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit.

With a blend of legal experience, empathy and a steadfast dedication to his clients' well-being, Mr. Joerres embodies the essence of a compassionate advocate, steadfastly fighting for justice both inside and outside the courtroom.
